nom: COOLA Classic Face Sunscreen Mist SPF 50

avis.titre: I bought this on vacation and thats how long it lasted.
avis.texte: I bought the Coola Classic Face Mist SPF 50 on vacation from an onsite spa. The location I stayed at had a lazy river and the product helped me from getting burnt. However, once I got home I tried using this on my face on a hot summer day and broke out instantly in a rash that persisted for a week. Luckily, I work with estheticians who helped me find the right remedy. I tossed the product and took no further action. Then I found another bottle that I ordered from the FSA store and the same thing happened. Luckily, I had the remedy on hand and do not have to hide my face this week. I would not recommend unless you are going to use the whole bottle on your vacation immediately after opening.
I developed hives after using this product over a period of days.
As others have noted, its very chemical smelling. It also doesn't seem to work very well.

I enjoyed the previous version with a fine continuous mist and wish for it's return. The new pump top unscrewed in transit and leaks. It smells different. It's oilier. Does not work for me anymore which is disappointing because I loved the previous version and used it daily. (I do love Coola spf face lotion.

I absolutely love this product. I went on vacation this month and used this every single day. It applies easily onto the skin and has such a nice smell. It's great for sensitive skin as I didn't find it harsh whatsoever. The packaging is clearly very high quality and even when traveling I had no problem with spillage or any other packaging problems. This sunscreen allowed me to get a tan without the suns harmful UV rays. I love that the spf is high enough that it protects from the sun without completely interfering with your ability to tan. I also noticed that I didn't need to be constantly reapplying this product outside of the application instructions. It stayed on really well throughout the day and even when I went into the ocean. I recommend this to anyone who is going on a trip or just needs daily sun protection. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Wow this is a game changer. living in colorado i use facial sunscreen every single day of the year. but sometimes ill forget to put it on under my makeup and then i have to go without it or redo my makeup. this product has been a game changer. the spf 50 is amazing and i love that i can spray it on top of my makeup and it gives me a slight radiant glow and i can also use it as a touchup throughout the day. i know you're always supposed to reapply sunscreen throughout the day but i never have because its been a hassle this makes it super easy to reapply and get full sun protection all day. im loving this sunscreen mist. I will definitely be packing this in my to go bag this summer to bring on hikes and to fairs and festivals. it makes me actually want to reapply and that makes it worth it **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

It disperses a fine mist spray, making application a breeze. It dries fast, which is great for quick changeovers. Most if all, it does not irritate my eyes or burn my skin. It doesn't have a noticeable scent. I also have not any sunburn since starting to use this.The packaging makes it a convenient staple for my tennis bag. I will definitely be repurchasing this one. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

The Coola Classic Face Mist is so neat! The Face mist stands out because it's quick and easy to apply. It's light on the face and absorbs fast. The mist comes out evenly. I have sensitive skin but the Coola Classic Face Mist did not burn my face. It had a refreshing cooling tingle. My face felt normal after application of the mist. My face felt soft and not tight. This COOLA Suncare Classic Face Sunscreen Mist SPF 50 is easy and convenient for reapplying sun protection. I love how it comes in a regular spray bottle instead of the typical aerosol spray bottle. The spray bottle is also portable and a perfect size to put in a bag for on-the-go sunscreen application. The nozzle works smoothly and sprays a fine mist that disperses evenly without drenching my face. It dries quickly, goes on clear, and absorbs well without leaving a greasy appearance. The finish is semi-matte, and there is no white cast. The scent itself is subtle, but there is some alcohol smell that fades after a while. It is water-resistant for up to 80 minutes and layers well when applied over makeup. I also didn't experience any issue while reapplying it throughout the day. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I gave this mist a good shot, but unfortunately it was a miss. This spray is indeed very lightweight, as it says. I would describe it as a dry oil, and it has an incredibly fine mist. It would be very hard to over do it and become greasy looking. I think with the formula, it would be a nice touch up spray too. It's just so easy. Those are the pros. The cons for me are first the smell. It's strong, and reminds me of a mix between bug spray and rubbing alcohol. Unfortunately, that right off was a deal breaker- I had to wipe it off. Second, I have a feeling the bottle would leak in a pool bag. When opening it, I had it tilted to the side a little. It was leaking around the pump nozzle. . It's a shame, the rest of Coola's sun products are amazing. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I love SPFs, and this one is pretty nice. This mist doesn't leave any white, greasy finish. It has a clear texture and is so easy to apply and reapply. I love the fact that it is water-resistant. The design of the bottle is very nice, and the color is so pretty. The fact that it is organic means a lot to me. Overall, I love the fact that it has SPF 50 protection and that it comes in a compact size. It would be perfect for those who love grease-free sunscreen products with a great SPF for any skin type.I received this product as part of an educational promotion. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Easy, lightweight sunscreen for every day use.
avis.texte: I got an opportunity to try the Coola Suncare Classic Face Sunscreen Mist SPF50 and it's been really easy product to add into my routine. This sunscreen mist from Coola has made reapplying SPF so easy! I usually apply this on top of my SPF lotion and makeup. It really feels like I'm not wearing anything! It is so easy throw in your bag to bring on-the-go. Coola Face Sunscreen Mist is a convenient spray SPF that is easy to apply. The mist is lightweight, non-greasy, and hydrating on my skin. It absorbs well, and I appreciate that this facial sunscreen did not break out my acne-prone skin or cause irritation. It also did not leave a white cast, which some sunscreens tend to do. Although it claims to be fragrance-free, my sensitive nose can detect a slight scent; however, compared to other sunscreens, it is quite mild. This sunscreen is SPF 50 and waterproof, providing plenty of protection. I tried this mist on its own, as well as under and over makeup, and I was happy with the protection Coola provided. The size of the spray is perfect for portability in my purse, beach bag, or for any outdoor event. I highly recommend this plant-based sunscreen mist. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I really have loved all Coola products I've ever tried and this facial sunscreen was no exception. I found the scent light but nice and unique compared to what I have used before. I wish I knew more about what "plant protection" means on the bottle. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: One of the best face sunscreens I have ever tried

Like a lot of sunscreen products it does require to be reapplied throughout the day but I feel like this face mist really lacked for long day time wear and I find myself needing to reapply more often then i typically do. Overall i still would recommend this face mist but i would not say it exceeded or even meet the expectations i had for it. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: The easiest way to reapply SPF
avis.texte: You know what I like the most about sunscreen mists? How easy they make reapplying SPF throughout the day. I personally prefer using a cream or lotion sunscreen before makeup because I like something hydrating as my base, but let's be honest, reapplying sunscreen over makeup is usually a mess. Whit this mist you can be on the go and simply spray two or three times and you're protected again without ruining your makeup. It is SPF 50, water resistant and feels very lightweight on the skin. After spraying, I usually let it absorb for a bit and then gently press it into my skin with a clean sponge that I use only for this purpose and if needed, I'll lightly set it with a brush and translucent powder. This method works great for me and keeps my makeup looking fresh.I also love that it's organic and the price is very reasonable. Overall, this is one of the easiest and most practical ways to reapply sunscreen during the day and I definitely recommend it. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This clear spf 50 Coola sunscreen is amazing. The fact that is clear makes me so happy. No white cast ever!! This face organic sunscreen mist SPF 50 is a nice, standard sunscreen that is great for daily use. It provides sufficient sun protection, hydrates the skin, has a lightweight consistency, and does not give off a white cast. These are some of the most important things that I look for in a sunscreen, so I was satisfied to see that this product offered these things. I also appreciate how this product contains beneficial ingredients, including a plant protection complex and safflower seed oil, which work to effectively enhance the skin. I am always drawn to organic products such as this, because I want to try to avoid the use of harmful chemicals as best as I can. Additionally, the design of the packaging is aesthetically pleasing; I really like the vibrant blue and white colors. After application of the sunscreen mist, I did find that my skin was a bit shiny. The sunscreen mist also does have an alcohol scent. Other than that, this is a pretty nice product that I will continue to use. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I really wanted to love the Coola Classic Face Mist sunscreen but it has a very strong smell of alcohol that is hard to overlook. The formula is non-greasy and after spraying it doesn't leave any visible residue or white cast on my face. The packaging is pretty with the blue and teal ombré metal bottle, and the product is easy to dispense with the spray top. The small size works to throw into a beach bag or purse. The price point is comparable to other mid to luxury range facial sunscreen products. This face mist may work for people who aren't overly sensitive to scents but for me the strong alcohol smell is off putting. The scent issue with this product is strange because other Coola products I have tried have a pleasant coconut or cucumber scent. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I love the the idea of a lightweight SPF mist that I can spray over makeup. It is so convenient, and the formula is non-comedogenic according to the ingredients, meaning it's designed not to clog pores. This is a major plus for my acne-prone skin. The mist itself feels very light and breathable and dries down without a greasy or heavy finish, which I like for everyday wear and quick spf touch ups. It has a pleasant, natural scent and the texture is easy to layer without messing up my makeup. That said, I do find I have to spray carefully and more than once to get even coverage, and I definitely have to keep my eyes completely closed because it can sting if any gets in them. I haven't had any bad reactions to it so it seems like a perfect fit overall. It's a really good on the go SPF mist that works with acne-prone skin. The convenience is everything! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I generally prefer spray sunscreens like Coola's sunscreen for the convenience of application. This is a high quality face sunscreen, in an attractive blue bottle, that's easy to apply, dispense and use. The Coola sunscreen does have a fairly strong smell, but not unpleasant, and the scent is a familiar one to those who use sunscreen regularly. Its compact size makes it perfect for my on-the-go lifestyle, and it's so easy to apply with just a few spritzes.One of the best parts is that it is made with clean ingredients, so I can feel good about what I'm putting on my skin. The scent is subtle coconut notes that I absolutely adore!I haven't had any issues with irritation, and I love that I can apply it over makeup effortlessly. Plus, its long-lasting formula means my skin is highly protected for hours.I recommend this to anyone who is looking for sun protection that's easy to apply and effective. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Coola face mistNoozle: The spray nozzle is easy to press down, I didn't have to put a lot of pressure on my finger to get the mist to work. I will say the nozzle on the makeup setting spray only takes an inch less pressure to get the sunscreen onto your face.Mist: The sunscreen is a mist, which I don't know if it applied to every part of my face, like a traditional lotion sunscreen would do. I noticed the bottle says spray a little bit farther from you but learned it better to go a little closer because the first time it got my hair more than my face.Applying: When applying the sunscreen mist onto my face, it didn't feel like anything. I say this because one second my face felt the water mist, and then the next minute it completely dried down. There was no sticky residue feeling after, which some face mist products can give. I forgot after I had it on, and some sunscreens my eyes are sensitive they start to cry or sting, but with Coola, it didn't.Be careful of scratches on your skin: The main inactive ingredient is organic alcohol. I sprayed it on my face and felt I little burn. I realized I had a scab on the side of my face, that is why it happened. The burn lasted less than a minute and went away, if you have a cut or open scab be careful, spraying on it. I thought it was just my scratch fault but in general, it tingles the skin for only a couple of seconds then disappears.Scent: In my opinion, I like the Coola makeup setting and fragrance over the classic face mist Coola.

I am really like the COOLA Classic Face Mist SPF 50 sunscreen spray. I love how easy it is to apply it, just spray and go! It is a super lightweight non greasy formula that works very well. I can spray it directly onto my face with or without makeup on, which I absolutely love. The formula goes on so smoothly and effortlessly, giving me the perfect even application. When I wear it over my makeup you literally can not tell at all, it doesn't change or effect my makeup what so ever. No separation, and no pilling of my makeup. Just an even sun protected sunscreen mist. I love that it is an spf 50 sunscreen mist ensuring I am protected from the sun and harmful rays at all times. I am obsessed with the lightweight, non greasy, non sticky formula! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I like that this sunscreen mist applies super easily and in a very fine mist. It does have a stronger scent at first, but it does not linger long. It has a slight oily feel, but is still lightweight feeling. It has no white cast and leaves a dewy/shiny look. For that reason, I prefer to wear it on non-makeup days. This must is super convenient to take on the go and reapply throughout the day. I also like that it provides adequate sun protection (50 SPF) and is reef safe. I have normal skin type and this did not cause me any irritation, breakouts, or negative side effects. I am a beauty enthusiast who lives where it is humid and sunny, so I always wear sunscreen and look for one that reapplies well throughout the day. This one does just that! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Convenient Sun Protection On The Go
avis.texte: My background is retail and phytomedicine. I am a beauty enthusiast & skincare junkie.Fitzpatrick Scale Type 2Baumann Skin Type 4Coola Classic Face Mist SPF is a convenient and effective sun protection option for those on the go. The bright colored packaging is not only eye-catching but also convenient to carry around for reapplying throughout the day. What I like most about this SPF is the fine mist, it's lightweight and not sticky. The initial scent however, has a slight sunscreen smell that thankfully dissipates quickly and finishes with a clean fresh scent. This is a non-greasy formula making it perfect to apply over makeup or on its own. My skin tone on the Fitzpatrick scale is type 2 so, I wear SPF everyday and I appreciate that this Coola Face Mist is FSA/HSA approved, making it a no-brainer for me to continue purchasing.I recommend Coola Face Mist because it is a great option for anyone that needs easy and reliable sun protection, is fair skinned like myself, or needs a boost of hydration throughout the day with the added benefit of SPF. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: A mist have but can sting a bit
avis.texte: I am a 33 year old beauty enthusiast from Alabama. I am always looking to add SPF in my beauty routine as I have always believed prevention is one of the key ways to help with anti-aging. I was so excited to add this product into my daily routine as I rarely leave the house without some sort of SPF on. It was very easy to use, and I have used it both over makeup and on makeup free days. From my experience, the alcohol in this mist can sting for a few seconds once I apply it, but it doesn't last long! I feel a mist is perfect for touching up throughout the day especially when you already have makeup on already and want to touch up on SPF! This did dry my skin out a bit, so I personally will not be using it daily, but I will definitely use it a few times a week! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Unlike traditional sunscreens, it doesn't leave a sticky residue, making it an ideal choice for all skin types. The fine mist application ensures an even and sheer coverage without disrupting makeup.The convenience of using this sunscreen on its own or over makeup is a game-changer. It goes away and doesn't bother me too much. Overall, I love how easy it is to apply and that it doesn't leave a white filmy haze on my face after applying. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

So far I am really enjoying this product. It is super easy to use, just spray & go! It's formula is lightweight, non-greasy and non-irritating, dries quickly and leaves no tacky or sticky residue/feelings on the skin. The mist is cooling & refreshing, and the smell is mild and clean. I love that this product is water/sweat proof for up to 80 minutes, this will be perfect for day trips in the summer -- when I'll be outside more and exposed to the sun more. Right now, I love it as an every day refreshing facial mist, that will help protect my skin from any UV rays that are peeking through during the winter time. I've been spraying this after my morning skincare regimine, it is the perfect finishing touch to your skincare routine! Keep it in your bag & take it with you during the day for midday refreshes. Perfect size for home & on the go! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Touch-free way to apply face sunscreen
avis.texte: I have fair skin, am in my early 30s, and live in New York City. I love that I can spritz the KOOLA SPF on as the last step in my routine, whether or not I'm wearing makeup. It leaves a bit of a sheen, but I don't mind it. I tend to have dry skin so I like the dewy look, but if you have oily skin you might not like the sheen it gives you. I also love that you can reapply it without touching your face since the sunscreen in a spray bottle. I keep a bottle of this SPF in my bag for times when I'm out because I can apply it even if there's no sink nearby the wash my hands. Even though it's a regular spray bottle, if you hold down it sprays a little longer (almost like an aerosol) which is nice for a controlled mist. There is a light juniper smell. (It almost smells like a gin and tonic?) But the smell is only initial and then it disappears. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

The organic cools classic face mist sunscreen it was my first time to use them by the way. I like that it is both face mist and sunscreen. It's a non greasy lightweight sunscreen and isn't sticky onto skin. I like you can wear over make up too and you can bring anywhere outside. The bottle size is perfect actually and one thing I've noticed that there is a mild smell which it is tolerable for me. I'm not sure to anyone the smell. Overall, I like the face mist sunscreen isn't drying on my skin the product and it has the SPF50 to protect our skin from harmful UV rays **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

As a Beauty Enthusiast and very fair-skinned person, I love trying new sunscreen products! I'm always looking for new sunscreen products that won't mess with my makeup looks but will still give me the protection I need. The COOLA Classic Face Organic Sunscreen Mist SPF 50 does that! It is easy to spray on, and I love the packaging. It's lightweight and doesn't feel oily or heavy. You don't have to rub it in at all, and it dries on my skin quickly enough that I can layer my makeup right overtop with ease. I love that I can also apply it over my makeup throughout the day! It can be so hard to keep up with reapplying sunscreen as often as I should (especially if I'm proud of my makeup that day) but this product makes it so much easier! I also really like that it's water-resistant/sweat-resistant and a higher SPF level- it's perfect for when I'm going for a run outside, and I'm excited to use it over the summer while swimming. The only thing I don't love about this product is the scent- personally, I find it a little overpowering and I'm not a huge fan of it. I do find that the scent fades fairly quickly though, and it's not enough of a deterrent for me to stop using it. Overall I would definitely recommend this product to anyone looking for a facial sunscreen that will keep their skin safe without messing up their makeup! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I love this organic SPF 50 it's so easy to use just spray and go , I can use this over my makeup has amazing coverage , it doesn't leave a white cast it's a lightweight spray it's non greasy and it's water resistant up to 80 minutes , it has amazing antioxidant rich ingredients like Buriti Oil and Prickly Pear extract, this is my favorite SPF by far, I love COOLA products , it's dermatologist tested, cruelty free & vegan .. this is great product because I'm always outside gardening and by the pool so I know I'm always protected from the sun , I love that it's really easy to use it's not messy , it makes me feel good that im using such a well known amazing brand and I know I'm using something good on my skin that makes me feel happy . Thank you for making such incredible products.. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I love how easy this sunscreen is to apply. As someone who is very consistent with their sunscreen use, I'm always looking for a high-quality sunscreen that I can easily reapply. I never tried a spray-on face sunscreen before and I really like this one! I do find it a little difficult to make sure that I get a full, even coverage, but that's probably because I'm just not used to using it. The mist is fine and it doesn't make you look too greasy after application. Love that there is no white cast and that it's SPF 50 and waterproof. It works great over makeup too! I just wait for it to dry a little before applying a setting powder on top to make my face look more matte. I rate it 4/5 stars only because of the smell - it has that strong sunscreen/bug spray smell that I dislike. After some time I did get used to it, though. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Perfect for on the go refresh
avis.texte: This is such a great option to refresh and reapply your face sunscreen throughout the day to get your spf! I often wear makeup and do not want to mess up and smudge it. However, you are supposed to be reapplying your spf every couple hours. This must allows me to reapply without messing up my makeup. It's great. It is very easy to toss in my purse or in my beach bag so I can easily spray on the go. I also really appreciate how it is clear. It does not leave any sort of white cast. This is awesome because I do not need to rely on having a mirror handy to make sure every thing is spread out evenly. I also spray this in my neck and shoulders in addition to my face. It does have a slight smell but I do not mind as it is great protection from the sun. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I am a skincare lover and wear SPF every day. Love the packaging and so easy to use. Had no issues with any leaking from the bottle. Fits comfortably in your hand. Sprays in a fine mist so you don't need to use a ton of product. Feels refreshing on the skin, drys quickly and leaves no white cast, greasy feel or product build up. Slight scent that goes away after a few minutes, didn't bother me like some reviewers and I am sensitive to smells. I have only used on bare skin so I'm not sure if it would work over makeup. The perfect product to have on hand for a day at the beach or pool. Will definitely be using this a lot this summer. Really enjoying this and can't wait to try more from this brand. Highly recommend you give Cool a try you won't be disappointed! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I have a bit of a love/hate with the Coola Classic Face Sunscreen Mist. As someone who religiously wears SPF, I appreciate that this is a totally invisible sunscreen with 50 spf, so it offers a high level of protection. It is really convenient to just spray on and go. The mist is super fine and it leaves the skin with a nice glow. It dries on the skin almost instantly, which makes it a little difficult to tell when you've sprayed enough or that you've covered your whole face. It was much easier when I was applying it to other people to tell when they had complete coverage. However, my biggest problem with this sunscreen is the smell. To me, it smells like dirt and bug spray. It isn't pleasant, and I could smell it on my skin all day. It was really off-putting to me, and ultimately a deal breaker. If it doesn't bother you, this is a nice formula. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I absolutely adore this Coola classic organic sunscreen face mist with spf 50. I live in Florida so for me, sunscreen is a must. I'm obsessed with skincare and this sunscreen mist feels so nice on my skin. It doesn't have the usual sunscreen smell and it did not leave my skin feeling oily or greasy. Since I'm a mom I need products that make my life easier and this is something that is so quick and easy to just spray on. No need to rub it in. I also can just put this in my purse. Perfect for on the go and so that I can easily reapply throughout the day. I've been using this for a few days and haven't noticed any irritation or breakouts. I have oily acne prone skin and sometimes all products don't agree with my skin, but this sunscreen really worked amazingly well. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.
